sectors.name: Technology
themes: Indonesia's digital infrastructure buildout continues to drive outsized gains in niche tech names like DMMX and TRON, independent of global sentiment.
Local tech valuations remain disconnected from US peers, creating arbitrage opportunities for fast-moving institutional capital in small-cap IDX listings.
Regulatory tailwinds for fintech and e-commerce in Indonesia are accelerating, favoring issuers with direct consumer exposure over pure B2B plays.
sectors.ai: Buy selectively into DMMX, TRON, and ELIT on momentum, but cap exposure until IDX tech breadth confirms a breakout above the 50-day. Rotate out of laggards like INET and LITE into names with earnings catalysts. US tech strength supports the sector, but WATCH signal means take profits on 10%+ runners and re-enter on pullbacks.

Regional commodity export cycles (nickel, palm oil) drive bulk logistics volumes, making LOPI and LRNA leveraged plays on China's industrial demand recovery.
sectors.ai: Buy logistics on the watch signal: MITI's +15% surge confirms domestic 3PL momentum, while SAFE and SDMU gains signal cold-chain and last-mile strength. Rotate into Indonesian names over US peers—ID +1.39% outperformance persists on e-commerce and commodity flows. Add on pullbacks, targeting MITI and SAFE for Q3 earnings catalysts; avoid chasing CHRW's single-day spike.
